result:
The users page now has a search box, a role filter and an Export CSV button. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of it is checked.

- **Filter and search:** the search box matches first name, last name or email, ignoring case. The role filter offers All roles, Admin and User. Both filter in the browser on the list the page already loads, and the table shows only the matching users. The page was already limited to admins, so I added no extra check.
- **Export CSV:** the button downloads `users.csv` with the users currently shown and four columns: Name, Email, Role and Joined. The date uses `formatDate`. It is disabled when no users match.
- **Spreadsheet safety:** cells that start with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading `'`, so a spreadsheet won't run them as formulas.

The page changes are in `src/features/users/components/users-list.tsx`. The CSV code is a new shared file, `src/utils/csv.ts`, with no feature imports.

`Input` and `Select` in `@/components/ui/form` are built for `react-hook-form` and require a `registration` prop. I pass `registration={{}}` for the search box and an `onChange` handler through `registration` for the role select. That works with the current components, but it is a little awkward.

I compare `user.role` to the selected filter value directly. Your rule says never to compare `user.role` yourself for role checks. I read that as access checks, not data filtering. If you meant it for this too, tell me and I'll change it.
